description:
This plugin allows users to sign in through an SSO provider (such as Google, Facebook, or your own provider). This enables one-click signin.
The Alphabet Cartel build (pbd) of k0lin/jellyfin-plugin-sso.
Review documentation at https://github.com/The-Alphabet-Cartel/jellyfin-plugin-sso
name: SSO Authentication (pbd)
overview: Authenticate users against an SSO provider.

versions.changelog:
## 5.1.1.2 (pbd)

New accounts are now named after the member's sign-in username, and members can set their own password for apps.

### Added
- **New account name claim** (OpenID provider setting). Names a new account from a claim such as `preferred_username`, while the username claim (for example `sub`) stays the key the account is linked by. With it set, a sign-in is never matched to an existing account by name.
- **App password** on `/SSOViews/linking`. Accounts created by SSO can set a password once, so they can sign in to apps that only take a username and password. Minimum 8 characters. Later changes go through the normal Jellyfin profile page.

### Changed
- A brand-new account is taken to the self-service page after its first sign-in, to set that password.
- If a sign-in is refused (for example, the account name is already taken), the page now says why instead of showing a blank screen.

### Setup
Set **New account name claim** to `preferred_username` on the provider, save, and restart Jellyfin.
Fix self-service account linking creating a new user instead of linking.
